name: multi-select
description: Renders a question with N checkbox options. Agents attach with --param question="..." --param options="a,b,c" to ask the user to select zero or more options via UI instead of free-text.

options.description: Comma-separated list of option labels, or a JSON-encoded string array.

min.description: Minimum number of selections required to enable Submit. Defaults to 1.

max.description: Maximum number of selections allowed (advisory; not currently enforced in UI).
